layout.note: Read all 245 output rows in both languages. The four refined rows are right: r00014 one paired row then three Arabic-only rows; r00015 four pairs; r00016 two pairs; r00127 four pairs. Remaining pairing defects, all at original row boundaries and now fixable with the merge tool: in r00017, r00021, r00038, r00039, r00047, r00048, r00050, r00055, r00057, r00155, r00156 and r00185 the Arabic ends with a piece whose Persian stands at the head of the following row. In my earlier review I tolerated these because no cross-row tool existed. Also r00013 and r00047 need the finer cuts named in their notes. The remaining rows are at the pilot level and their pairing is accepted.
